contexts.text: Two maidservants (of the Antediluvians), seen. SE 3378.
(Abram) had... maidservants, and she-donkeys () = ... the pleasures of scientifics.

(Sarai) had a handmaid, an Egyptian () = the affection of knowledges... This affection, being of the exterior man, ought to serve intellectual truth... as a handmaid serves her mistress, or a maidservant her lady; and therefore this affection is that which is signified by the handmaid Hagar. Explained.
Go in to my handmaid () = conjunction with what is exterior. AC 1914.
(Abimelech took) men-servants and maid-servants () = (an enriching) also with rational truths and natural truths, and also with the affections thereof. Explained, Illustrated.
Men-servants and maid-servants = lower truths and goods.
Men-servants = the truths, and maid-servants the goods, which are of service. Illustrated.

Maid-servants = the goods of these truths; which goods, being lower ones, ought indeed to serve, but in a different manner; and therefore some of the laws delivered concerning maidservants differ from those delivered concerning men-servants; for, regarded in themselves, truths are servants more than their goods are. Illustrated.

And his maid-servants () = as to the affections of doctrinal things; (for) maid-servants = the affections of rational and scientific things; here, of doctrinal things, because they are predicated of the doctrine of faith; for they belonged to Abimelech.

Cast out this handmaid and her son () = that the things of the merely human Rational should be banished... The handmaid = the affection of rational and scientific things; thus the good of them. AC 3264.
A handmaid = external affections. Explained.
These media are what are signified by the handmaids... AC 3913:4.
A handmaid = a medium which serves.
A handmaid = an affirmative medium which serves for the conjunction of the external and the internal man. References.
(Jacob had) maid-servants and men-servants () = mediate goods and truths; that is, natural ones themselves; (for) maidservants = the affections of the Natural, consequently the goods there. AC 4153.
A maid-servant = the affection of (interior natural) truth.
The two handmaids (Bilhah and Zilpah) () = the exterior affections of truth which serve as media.
Handmaids = the affections of knowledges and of Knowledges; and also the media which serve for the conjunction of the external and internal man. References. AC 4345.
The handmaids = the affections of knowledges and of Knowledges, which are of the external man; consequently sensuous scientifics. Explained.
The maid-servants and men-servants (in a house) = the pleasures and scientifics which minister and confirm.
A maid-servant = the affection of exterior truth, or the affection of knowledges; but the maid-servant behind the mills () = the affection of knowledges which is in the highest degree external.
Thy maidservant () = the Natural as to good.
A maidservant = the affection of spiritual Explained.
When a man shall sell his daughter for a maidservant () = the affection of truth from natural delight... A maidservant = external or natural affection. Explained.

There are those who are in truth and not in its affection, and there are those who are in its affection; the former were represented by the man-servants from the sons of Israel, and the latter by the maidservants also from the sons of Israel. But by the maidservants were not represented those who are in the genuine affection of truth, but those who are in a non-genuine one. Further explained.
A maidservant of whom it is said that she is evil, = affection from natural delight.
That a maidservant = the affection of truth from the delights of the love of self or of the love of the world... and that this affection can be conjoined with spiritual truth...
But betrothal or conjunction with a maidservant differs from conjunction with a daughter in this: that the latter conjunction is effected in the interior man, but the former in the external man.

When a man shall smite his man-servant or his maidservant with a rod () = if anyone within the Church ill-treats scientific truth or the affection thereof from his own power... A maidservant = natural affection; thus the affection of scientifics.
Or the eye of his maidservant () = (if he shall injure) the affection of truth in the External... A maidservant = the affection of natural truth.
If he shall strike out the tooth of his manservant or the tooth of his maidservant () = if he shall destroy truth or the affection thereof in the Sensuous.
If an ox shall strike with the horn a manservant or a maidservant () = if the affection of evil has destroyed truth or good in the Natural... A maidservant = the affection of truth in the Natural.

The son of a maidservant () = those who are in the affection of external truth; for... a maidservant = external affection... By the son of a maidservant are here signified those who are outside the Church... because they are from a lower origin.
(Let not the men consider their wives as viler than their maidservants.)
Thou shalt not covet thy... maidservant, etc. Explained.
She effected the destruction of two maidservants...
By the man-servant and the maidservant (in the tenth commandment) are meant the affection of rational truth and good which serves the Spiritual.
Those who speak much about God, and yet are quite regardless about cheating men and plundering them of their goods, commit adultery with maidservants, whom they often change.
